headline: Rogers State score through ten different players
dek: Their win at home to Oklahoma Christian on Wednesday made it five matches without defeat, with thirteen goals scored and four conceded. No other programme has had more than seven different scorers, and only Ouachita Baptist have had that many.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Rogers State have outscored Newman, Northeastern State and Harding put together.

wire.line: Harding have lost all four of their matches, conceding ten goals and scoring once.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Newman have lost four matches in a row since their opening win at William Jewell, the latest at Lubbock Christian on Thursday.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Ouachita Baptist's ten goals have come from seven different players, and the three they have conceded all came in the defeat by Dallas Baptist.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Reik Barrack is Harding's only scorer this season; their one goal came in the defeat by Christian Brothers.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Tristan Miller has conceded four goals for Rogers State and kept two shutouts, the second of them against Oklahoma Christian on Wednesday.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Southern Nazarene have won two and lost two, the defeats coming in their first match, at home to Maryville, and their latest, at Midwestern State on Thursday.

last_match.line: Newman have not won since their opening night at William Jewell; Lubbock Christian host Fort Hays State on Saturday.

next_match.line: Lubbock Christian beat Newman on Thursday; Fort Hays State have lost only to Regis and have not played since drawing with Fort Lewis.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
